name: Crimson Path
body:
School conjuration (teleportation); Level antipaladin 4, lathspell 4, magus 5, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 5, unchained summoner 5, witch 5

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cut your palm dealing 1 damage and touch a living creature, violently and bloodily entering their body, and exiting in a similar fashion from a nearby creature.

You teleport 10 feet when touching Small or smaller creatures and the distance teleported doubles for each size category larger than small. Medium would be 20 feet, Large 40, and so on. The touched creature and the endpoint creature must make Fortitude saves or be dealt 1d6 damage per caster level (maximum 15d6). A successful saving throw halves this damage but does not prevent the teleportation. This spell cannot use bloodless creatures as a target or end point. If there is no valid endpoint creature available, this spell fails. You cannot enter and exit the same creature.
